name: open3d_bunny
title: Stanford bunny (Open3D demo mesh)
description: The Stanford bunny as shipped by open3d.data.BunnyMesh. The file carries no unit; the original scan is in metres (the bunny is about 15 cm long).

citation: Turk G., Levoy M. Zippered polygon meshes from range images. SIGGRAPH 1994.
